# ntnu-report-ethical-hacking
A Typst template for the IIK3100 report. It is based on the docx template given by the teacher.

## Usage
You can use this template in the Typst web app by clicking "Start from template" on the dashboard and searching for `ntnu-report-ethical-hacking`.

Alternatively, you can use the CLI to kick this project off using the command
```
typst init @preview/ntnu-report-ethical-hacking
```

Typst will create a new directory with all the files needed to get you started.

## Configuration
The template gives you a pre-filled main.typ from where you can start writing your report.

You will have to fill your name and email at the beginning of the template. After that, you can complete the different table and write your report in a fast and easy way !
